name: presentations
description: Design and build slide decks as native PowerPoint or HTML, styled from brand presets

interface.shortDescription: Build PowerPoint and HTML slide decks with brand presets
interface.longDescription: Six skills covering the full presentation lifecycle: designing-presentations plans the content into a deck.md storyboard, building-pptx-decks builds it as a native structured PowerPoint (or fills a client template, or edits an existing deck), creating-presentations renders and perfects multi-slide HTML decks with a two-window presenter view, editing-presentations runs a local editor where the user clicks slide elements and the agent reads the selection, exporting-presentations-to-pptx converts an HTML deck into native editable PowerPoint, and extracting-presets turns brand material into reusable presets.
defaultPrompt: Build a presentation from this document
